translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
Haa-Meem .
yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .

hum ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur inn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko kissi bar-haq maqsad kay baghair aur kissi mutayyan miyaad kay baghair peda nahi kerdiya hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh uss cheez say mun morray huye hain jiss say unhen khabrdar kiya gaya hai .

tum unn say kaho kay :  kiya tum ney unn cheezon per kabhi ghor kiya hai jinn ko tum Allah kay siwa pukartay ho-? mujhay dikhao to sahi kay unhon ney zameen ki konsi cheez peda ki hai ? ya aasmano ( ki takhleeq ) mein unn ka koi hissa hai-? meray paas koi aesi kitab lao jo iss Quran say pehlay ki ho , ya phir koi riwayat jiss ki buniyad ilm per ho ,   agar tum waqaee sachay ho .

uss shaks say bara gumrah kon hoga jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ( mann gharrat deotaon ) ko pukaray jo qayamat kay din tak uss ki pukar ka jawab nahi dey saktay , aur jinn ko inn ki pukar ki khabar tak nahi hai .
aur jab logon  ko mehshar mein jama kiya jaye ga to woh inn kay dushman ban jayen gay , aur inn ki ibadat hi say munkir hon gay .

aur jab inn kay samney humari aayaten apni poori wazahat kay sath parh ker sunai jati hain , to yeh kafir log haq baat kay unn tak phonch janey kay baad bhi uss kay baaray mein yun keh detay hain kay yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .

kiya inn ka kehna yeh hai kay issay payghumber ney apni taraf say gharr liya hai ? keh do kay :  agar mein ney issay apni taraf say gharr liya hai to tum mujhay Allah ki pakar say zara bhi nahi bacha sako gay .   jo baaten tum banatay ho , woh unhen khoob janta hai . meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawah banney kay liye woh kafi hai , aur wohi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

kaho kay :  mein payghumberon mein koi anokha payghumber nahi hun . mujhay maloom nahi hai kay meray sath kiya kiya jaye ga , aur naa yeh maloom hai kay tumharay sath kiya hoga-? .   mein kissi aur cheez ki nahi , sirf uss wahi ki perwi kerta hun jo mujhay bheji jati hai . aur mein to sirf aik wazeh andaz say khabrdar kernay wala hun .

kaho kay :  zara mujhay yeh batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say ho , aur tum ney uss ka inkar kerdiya , aur bano Israel mein say aik gawah ney iss jaisi baat kay haq mein gawahi bhi dey di , aur uss per emaan bhi ley aaya ,   aur tum apney ghamand mein mubtala rahey ( to yeh kitney zulm ki baat hai-? ) yaqeen jano kay Allah aesay logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata jo zalim hon .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh emaan laney walon kay baaray mein yun kehtay hain kay :  agar yeh ( emaan lana ) koi achi baat hoti to yeh log iss baaray mein hum say sabqat naa ley jasaktay .    aur jab inn kafiron ney iss say khud hidayat hasil nahi ki to woh to yehi kahen gay kay yeh wohi puraney zamaney ka jhoot hai .

aur iss say pehlay musa ki kitab rehnuma aur rehmat ban ker aa-chuki hai . aur yeh ( Quran ) woh kitab hai jo arbi zaban mein hotay huye uss ko sacha bata rahi hai ,   takay inn zalimon ko khabrdar keray , aur naik kaam kernay walon kay liye khushkhabri ban jaye .
yaqeenan jinn logon  ney yeh keh diya hai kay :  humara perwerdigar Allah hai  phir woh uss per sabit qadam rahey ,   to unn per naa koi khof taari hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .
woh jannat walay log hain jo hamesha uss mein rahen gay . yeh unn aemal ka badla hoga jo woh kiya kertay thay .

aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden say acha bartao kernay ka hukum diya hai .   uss ki maa ney bari mushaqqat say ussay ( pet mein ) uthaye rakha , aur bari mushaqqat say uss ko jana , aur uss ko uthaye rakhney aur uss kay doodh churraney ki mauddat tees maheenay hoti hai ,   yahan tak kay jab woh apni poori tawanai ko phonch gaya , aur chaalees saal ki umar tak phonch gaya to woh kehta hai kay :  yaar rab ! mujhay tofiq dijiye kay mein aap ki uss naimat ka shukar ada kerun jo aap ney mujhay aur meray maa baap ko ata farmaee , aur aesay naik amal kerun jinn say aap razi hojayen , aur meray liye meri aulad ko bhi salahiyat dey dijiye . mein aap kay huzoor tauba kerta hun , aur mein farmanbardaaron mein shamil hun .

yeh woh log hain jinn say hum unn kay behtareen aemal qubool keren gay , aur unn ki khataon say darguzar keren gay , ( jiss kay nateejay mein ) woh jannat walon mein shamil hon gay , uss sachay waday ki badolat jo unn say kiya jata tha .

aur aik woh shaks hai jiss ney apney walaiden say kaha hai kay :  tuff hai tum per ! kiya tum mujh say yeh wada kertay ho kay mujhay zinda ker kay qabar say nikala jaye ga , halankay mujh say pehlay boht si naslen guzar chuki hain .  aur walaiden Allah say fariyad kertay hain , ( aur betay say kehtay hain kay : )  afsos hai tujh per , emaan ley aa . yaqeen jaan kay Allah ka wada sacha hai .  to woh kehta hai kay :  inn baaton ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi hai kay yeh mehaz afsaney hain jo pichlay logon  say naqal hotay chalay aarahey hain .

yeh woh log hain jinn kay baaray mein jinnaat aur insanon kay unn girohon samet jo inn say pehlay guzray hain , ( azab ki ) baat tey hochuki hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain .
aur her aik ( giroh ) kay apney aemal ki wajeh say mukhtalif darjay hain , aur iss liye hain takay Allah unn ko unn kay aemal ka poora poora badla dey . aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .

aur uss din ko yaad rakho jab inn kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  tum ney apney hissay ki achi cheezen apni dunyawi zindagi mein khatam ker daalen ,   aur inn say khoob maza ley liya , lehaza aaj tumhen badlay mein zillat ki saza milay gi , kiyonkay tum zameen mein nahaq takabbur kiya kertay thay , aur kiyonkay tum nafarmani kay aadi thay .

aur qoam-e-aad kay bhai ( hazrat Hood aleh-assalam ) ka tazkarah kero , jab unhon ney apni qoam ko kham daar teelo ki sarzameen mein   khabrdar kiya tha aur aesay khabrdar kernay walay unn say pehlay bhi guzar chukay hain , aur unn kay baad bhi kay :  Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat naa kero , mujhay tum per aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .
unhon ney kaha :  kiya tum humaray paas iss liye aaye ho kay humaray khudaon say hamen bargushta kero-? acha agar tum sachay ho to ley aao hum per woh ( azab ) jiss ki dhamki dey rahey ho .

unhon ney farmaya :  theek theek ilm to Allah kay paas hai ( kay woh azab kab aaye ga-? ) mujhay jo paygham dey ker bheja gaya hai , mein to tumhen wohi paygham phoncha raha hun , albatta mein yeh zaroor dekh raha hun kay tum aesay log ho jo nadani ki baaten ker rahey ho .

phir huwa yeh kay jab unhon ney uss ( azab ) ko aik badal ki shakal mein aata dekha jo unn ki wadiyon ka rukh ker raha tha to unhon ney kaha kay :  yeh badal hai jo hum per barish barsaye ga .  nahi ! balkay yeh woh cheez hai jiss ki tum ney jaldi machai thi aik aandhi jiss mein dardnak azab hai ,

jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say her cheez ko tehas nehas ker daalay gi ! gharz unn ki halat yeh hogaee kay unn kay gharon kay siwa kuch nazar nahi aata tha . aesay mujrim logon  ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

aur ( aey arab kay logo ! ) hum ney unn logon  ko unn baaton ki taqat di thi jinn ki taqat tumhen nahi di , aur hum ney unn ko kaan , aankhen aur dil sabb kuch dey rakhay thay , lekin naa unn kay kaan aur unn ki aankhen unn kay kuch kaam ayen , aur naa unn kay dil , kiyonkay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unhen aa-ghera .
aur hum ney aur bastiyon ko bhi halak kiya hai jo tumharay ird-gird waqay then ,   jabkay hum tarah tarah ki nishaniyan ( unn kay ) samney laa-chukay thay , takay woh baaz aajayen .

phir unhon ney Allah ka taqarrub  hasil kernay kay liye jinn cheezon ko Allah kay siwa mabood bana rakha tha , unhon ney unn ki kiyon madad naa kerli-? iss kay bajaye woh sabb unn kay liye bey nishan hogaye . yeh to unn ka sarasar jhoot tha , aur bohtan tha jo unhon ney tarash rakha tha .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab hum ney jinnaat mein say aik giroh ko tumhari taraf mutawajjah kiya kay woh Quran sunen ,   chunacheh jab woh wahan phonchay to unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha kay :  khamosh hojao  phir jab woh parha ja-chuka to woh apni qoam kay paas unhen khabrdar kertay huye wapis phonchay .

unhon ney kaha :  aey humari qoam kay logo ! yaqeen jano hum ney aik aesi kitab suni hai jo musa ( aleh-assalam ) kay baad nazil ki gaee hai , apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hai , haq baat aur seedhay raastay ki taraf raahnumai kerti hai .
aey humari qoam kay logo ! Allah kay daee ki baat maan lo , aur uss per emaan ley aao , Allah tumharay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur tumhen aik dardnak azab say panah dey dey ga .

aur jo koi Allah kay daee ki baat naa maaney to woh sari zameen mein kahen bhi jaker Allah ko aajiz nahi ker-sakta , aur Allah kay siwa uss ko kissi qisam kay rakhwalay bhi nahi milen gay . aesay log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

kiya inn ko yeh sujhai nahi diya kay woh Allah jiss ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur unn ko peda kernay say uss ko zara bhi thakan nahi hoi , woh yaqeenan iss baat per poori tarah qadir hai kay murdon ko zinda kerday-? aur kiyon naa ho-? woh beyshak her cheez ki poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

aur jiss din kafiron ko aag kay samney paish kiya jaye ga , uss din ( unn say poocha jaye ga ) kay kiya yeh ( dozakh ) sach nahi hai ? woh kahen gay kay :  humaray rab ki qasam ! yeh waqaee sach hai .  Allah irshad farmaye ga kay :  phir chakho maza azab ka , uss kufr kay badlay mein jo tum ney ikhtiyar ker rakha tha .

gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi tarah sabar kiye jao jaisay oolool-azm payghumberon ney sabar kiya hai , aur inn kay moamlay mein jaldi naa kero . jiss din yeh log woh cheez dekh len gay jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai , uss din ( enhen ) yun mehsoos hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ) din ki aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey .   yeh hai woh paygham jo phoncha diya gaya hai ! abb barbad to wohi log hon gay jo nafarman hain .
